notes.title: Patch 1.2 is coming!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38471925/26458eabe920cb21936356e0162a83950fe4addc.png[/img]

Hey, Champions

After the launch on Steam part of the team finally got something none of us had in almost 3 years of development... a little break. And... Ohh... it feels good to sleep more than 5 hours a night again! Although on break we kept working on bug fixing and balance issues, posting almost daily updates and fixes in order to make the game as stable as possible.

Now we are finally ready to launch the first major update from Grid Force - Mask of the Goddess since its launch. Patch 1.2!

Coming on Saturday, November 19, this patch includes the highly requested localization options for French, German, Portuguese and Spanish; rebalancing of the whole game's rerun; new visual and sound effects, a lot of optimization and, of course, lots of bug smashing.

And don't forget that quite soon you will be able to play Grid Force on XBOX and Nintendo Switch.

Thank you for sending us a ton of feedback and awesome reviews and don't forget to join our Discord and follow us on Twitter!

notes.title: Grid Force - Official Trailer & Release Date
notes.notes:
Hey there!

I’m Staples, one of the community managers and members of the marketing department at the former Playtra Games, and want to welcome you to this very special developer update. 

Not only has today’s blog post been a long time coming, but it’s got some massively important pieces of information about Grid Force - Mask of the Goddess.

So, allow me to waste no time, and jump right into it.

[h1]GRID FORCE - OFFICIAL TRAILER & RELEASE DATE[/h1]

After months of teasers and hints and, well, more teasers, I’m proud to present the official trailer for Grid Force - Mask of the Goddess, plus, the release date!

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=w0LYxc1GQrc]Click here to watch the trailer.[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38471925/adab1428bb800ee0208399976673ccf19518f8fe.jpg[/img]

And yes, you saw that correctly. 

[b]Grid Force - Mask of the Goddess will be released on the 11th of August, 2022.[/b]

And, if I can get serious for a moment, I am personally delighted that this trailer is finally available for your eyes and ears and whatever else you use to consume trailers. It’s been in the making for a long time, and, for those unaware, I edited this over the course of… a while, and through so many iterations and drafts that they practically reach the triple digits when you combine them all. 

Seeing it go from a crummy lil’ design document I wrote to an equally as crummy initial draft that used pantomimed emojis instead of actual footage (yes, really) to this final version has been quite the experience. 

Of course, a trailer like this can’t be made without one hell of a game to show off, and the team has done an incredible job of making Grid Force everything we believed it could and should be. I feel that’s best illustrated, right here, in the official trailer.

Plus, additional credit must go to our composer & SFX legend Nicola who provided the music for the trailer, as well as some crisp custom footage and much-needed moral support. And, our CEO and co-founder Dan, who’s a dab hand in After Effects, provided the visuals for the text on the title cards that really made the trailer pop. 

[i](If you find yourself lovin’ the trailer, please share it with everyone you can. Friends, family, pets, anyone. It’ll really help us out.)[/i]

[h1]WE’RE IN THE ENDGAME NOW[/h1]

Grid Force - Mask of the Goddess couldn’t be any closer. (Well, it could, but hush.)

Releasing on the 11th of August, you’ll finally be able to experience Grid Force in its entirety.

Remember to check out the trailer, wishlist Grid Force on Steam, take a crack at our latest demo, and mark your calendars for August 11th.

Take care, everyone!

- Staples [Community Manager at Playtra Games]

notes.title: Grid Force - Mask Of The Goddess December DevLog Update
notes.notes:
[h2]Here's a little update of what is going on behind the scenes[/h2]

Hey everyone, we've been quite busy lately, but we wanted to keep you in the loop of what is going on in the studio at Playtra. Let us know in the comments what excites you the most!

[h3]OPTIMIZATION[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38471925/8e6cd0bfc3fe2def883fd0177c095b0f35a46885.gif[/img]

So we want the game to run smoothly on multiple devices to make sure to reach those sweet 60 fps. Many many assets needed some rework. It's kind of a boring and exciting job at the same time. Going through a lot of assets and changing values, but when you see that you gained 2-3fps that's a pog moment.


[h3]LEVEL DESIGN[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38471925/b543262f2f4b68068b93aaf5a2df02cd55ecc08e.gif[/img]

After the beta and the feedback coming from the demo available on Steam, we started reworking the level design of many enemies and levels. This includes reworking the AIs and balancing the attacks (are we going to nerf Seke? Who knows ¯\(o_o)/¯ ) 


[h3]STORY IMPLEMENTATION[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38471925/98e824375c7ed785531b46cbe2188d7e6a70c4fa.gif[/img]

Believe it or not, we are very close to completing the story!!! No spoilers... but... it's gonna be incredible! Right now we are putting down the very final events, as well as creating faces expressions and effects for the dialogues. 


[h3]MUSIC[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38471925/667f06e3f51b43706471798c64b522f4e5eb9442.jpg[/img]

We are composing the music for the final stages. Btw, what's the best final boss battle song you've ever heard? Asking for a friend.

As always, may the goddess be with you!

————————

notes.title: Beta Patch 22-04-2021
notes.notes:
After the Closed Beta that we run for the past few weeks, we've been able to collect information about many bugs and issues affecting the game.

Here's a little list of the bugs that we managed to solve:

[b]Bugs that we believed we have fixed:[/b]
- Fixed a bug that prevented some characters to be selected during the boss fight against Tikaka
- Fixed a bug that made characters coming down outside the map in the mission with Balla in Forest of Kin
- Now the Desire Mask (Mainframe) has a longer cooldown and you cannot spam it
- Fixed a bug that prevented the background of the second level in the Temple of Dream to appear
- Fixed a bug that made the screen becoming grey in some areas of the game
- Fixed the final comic in Forest of Kin, now the text should be readable and it's not stretched
- Fixed a bug that made Donna stuck in an enemy tile after using her sword ability
- The "I killed the spy but apparently it runs away" bug
- During the fight when Elu joins, if you load the checkpoint she is still there.
- Koniko stuck in enemy tiles, even Balla couldn't move from there
- Reloading Checkpoint after getting Pan broke the game
- Elu not getting the right level
- Pop up not working on 4k screens
- UI still showing characters in your team even if they had left
- On some PC the screen shake so hard the brakes the camera position

[b]Bugs we couldn't replicate after a fix attempt, but we are not sure they are actually gone.[/b]
- Game freezing after the fight against Switch on the elevator
- After loading a checkpoint, not being able to select Koniko
- Donna slash not getting to the target correctly.

notes.title: Our biggest update!
notes.notes:
Our biggest update! It's a demo, but it offers hours of content.

[h3]What's new?[/h3]

First of all, every character now has 2 new skills. Here are a few examples:


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38471925/a8dd8babeefcd9d47dea321266611ab210eaf273.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38471925/acb23535e47d7b496f0a128e70f8fa080e702e81.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38471925/abc25ba6e7be247a12599dd484664afcb17be2fa.gif[/img]


Just for this demo, the skills are unlocked and ready to use. In the final release of the game, the extra skill will be an unlockable bonus that you receive by upgrading your characters. Introducing: sigils!

There is 5 type of sigils, each one of them as a chance to be dropped by your enemies:
[list]
[*] [b]Life[/b]
[*] [b]Void[/b]
[*] [b]Forces[/b]
[*] [b]Mind[/b]
[*] [b]Spirit[/b]
[*] [b]Matter[/b]
[/list]

The sigils can be spendable on your character to upgrade the stats such as life, speed, ether regeneration etc. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38471925/38119068bec6de681e749c3d647498f03a87973b.gif[/img]


How do you collect the sigils? After you complete the first mission of Tohora, you will be able to re-play it and fight against hordes of procedurally generated waves, with stronger enemies. Is it too hard for you? Collect more sigils, upgrade your characters and try again!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38471925/f2291fc604aead9307cddd634471be2de4c734cf.gif[/img]


And finally, the latest big update! We have officially changed the name of the game into GRID FORCE: MASK OF THE GODDESS.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38471925/4a0a1fa67a7f9f45fdd10d361c98c6d5e7e9314c.png[/img]

notes.title: Grid Fight - Mask Of The Goddess 🍁 Steam Game Festival Update
notes.notes:
[h1]Can you save this world before it reboots?
[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38471925/f11df9f1ce7816248229c19e32cc6a351d056d67.png[/img]

Grid Fight is a frantic action tactical game in the style of Mega Man Battle network with beautifully hand-drawn graphics and earworm soundtrack. 

The world has been rebooted, once again, by the Goddess Clea who chose Donna as her champion. Donna will lead a small group of heroines on her journey through the 9 cities of Gora, where she will meet her inhabitants, some will be willing to help, some others will be harder to convince.

Play the first hour of the game where you are introduced to the world of Gora, get to know your companions for this journey and face the first mad goddess. Plus, test your reflexes in a challenge level and see how far you can go.

In the first mission, you will find a real challenge, but don't worry there 8 of the 40 main characters to choose from, each with a different gameplay style. Create your favourite crew and start your mission.

Which kind of player are you? Are you interested in hearing the stories of Gora? We got you covered, your friends will tell you everything they know, you just have to ask. Are you not interested in the story? No issues, go on a rampage like a mindless drone and destroy everything that moves. But be careful, your choices may have consequences...

A stylish 2d world, upbeat music, powerful guns. Welcome to Grid Fight - Mask Of The Goddess!

Did you enjoy the demo? [url=https://discord.com/invite/grid-fight]Join the discord channel[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/Playtra_Games]follow us on Twitter[/url] for some dope prizes. 

Grid fight is close to release so don't forget to wishlist.
